value.rationale: Single-harmonic-degree recovery on E8 root lines is a canonical finite sampling problem beyond the known spherical 7-design strength. The exact all-even-degree rank diagram resolves identifiability for every degree, reveals a nonmonotone loss of only the mean at degree ten after degree-eight full interpolation, proves a sharp permanent recovery cutoff at degree twelve, gives exact projectors and minimum-norm interpolation, and supplies quantitative asymptotic conditioning. These are structurally motivated invariants with practical reconstruction interpretations, not an arbitrary recomputation of a graph spectrum.
